params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers may only use `view` and `embed`.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

items.docs: Lists reusable block patterns (`wp_block`). Registered and reachable, but empty (X-WP-Total 0) — the site is authored in Elementor rather than the block editor.

items.docs: Lists block-editor navigation menus (`wp_navigation`). Registered and reachable, but empty (X-WP-Total 0). The classic `/wp/v2/menus` and `/wp/v2/menu-locations` endpoints, which would carry the real site navigation, return 401 `rest_cannot_view` anonymously.
